newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine forex dealing system format changed.
newsitem.headline: Philippine forex dealing system format changed.

text.p: The Bankers Association of the Philippines (BAP) has changed the format of reporting peso dollar trades on its dealing system by dropping the last done deal, forex traders said on Monday.
BAP officials were not available for comment but traders said it had issued a memorandum informing them of the change. It did not give an explanation for the change.
Traders said the move was to put the Philippine peso dealing at par with other international markets which do not give the done rates but only the bid-and-offer quotes.
"Some traders have become too dependent on the last traded rates, that they made trading decisions based on that rate," one foreign exchange trader said.
The decision to omit the last traded rate, except for the closing price, was agreed upon during one of the fora of forex traders. "It was suggested long ago. Everybody was all for it," he added.
